customer.old_nib.name: Old Nib
customer.old_nib.order: Old Nib wants dust, and wants it now.
Old Nib is out of dust again.
Old Nib: bring the dust, keep the lecture.
customer.old_nib.thanks: Old Nib: not bad, not bad.
customer.old_nib.grumble: Old Nib sighs for a full minute.
Old Nib: I have seen better dust in a sock.
Old Nib writes your name on a list.
customer.moss_hat.name: Moss Hat
customer.moss_hat.order: Moss Hat is thirsty for mud.
